description: This file defines TypeScript types and function declarations related to tuple splitting and applying functions with bound parameters; it provides type-level utilities and a declaration for 'applyBind' function.

methods.name: declare function applyBind(...args: TupleSplit<Parameters<typeof actualApply>, 2>[1]): ReturnTyp/ applyBind
methods.description: A function that applies the 'actualApply' function with the last N parameters bound, returning the result of 'actualApply'.

ctags.name: TupleSplit
ctags.pattern: /^type TupleSplit<T extends any[], N extends number> = [TupleSplitHead<T, N>, TupleSplitTail<T, N>/

ctags.name: TupleSplitHead
ctags.pattern: /^type TupleSplitHead<T extends any[], N extends number> = T['length'] extends N$/

ctags.name: TupleSplitTail
ctags.pattern: /^type TupleSplitTail<T, N extends number, O extends any[] = []> = O['length'] extends N$/
